items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Horace Parlan, Mal Waldron, Horse Porlong, Mel Waldren, Knepper Jimmy Nipper, Clarence Shaw, Bookee Ervin.

ctx.x: What about some of the people who -- it's been said, and I think it's accurate, that the bands that you've had have really been the making of a lot of players. They've learned, it's like their college education. And a number of them have gone on to do very, very well, and a lot of them who seemed very promising never again played as well as they did play with they played with you. And I just wonder if you wanted to talk about some of the people that you had special good feelings about, who came through your bands?
Yeah, Horace Parlan, Mal Waldron, Horse Porlong, Mel Waldren, Knepper Jimmy Nipper, Clarence Shaw, Bookee Ervin.
Clarence Shaw, did anybody find him?
